title: Best GEO Experts (2026): Get Found in AI Search Answers
description: How to hire a GEO expert to help your brand appear in AI search answers and assistants: content, sources, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Generative engine optimization (GEO) experts help your business appear accurately in answers from AI assistants and AI-powered search. The work overlaps with SEO: clear, trustworthy content, consistent business information, mentions on reputable sites and pages that answer real questions directly. Projects go wrong when experts promise guaranteed AI mentions, create spammy content, or ignore the basics of a good website. This guide helps you hire someone who builds lasting visibility.

faq.a: It builds on SEO. Both reward clear, accurate, well-structured content and a trustworthy reputation. GEO adds attention to how AI tools summarize and cite information.

faq.q: Can anyone guarantee my brand appears in AI answers?
faq.a: No. AI tools change often and decide independently what to show. Be wary of guarantees.
Track mentions in AI answers for your key questions, referral traffic from AI tools and traditional search performance.
